description: Numbered capability/feature row used by the Capabilities grid section. Some entries open an image modal (CapabilityModal) instead of being plain text.

card.description: SAFE-page variant flag: renders as a bordered card instead of a plain row

motion.modalOpen: CapabilityModal opens on click, closes on Escape/outside-click/X
motion.reducedMotionFallback: modal open/close has no transition, appears/disappears instantly
